topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I can't believe they're splitting Gran's house like it's just some piece of property, some random thing. It's got so much history, so much of her in it. How can they just talk about selling it or arguing over who gets what room? This is the house where we all came together, where we learned who we were and where we came from. It's not just walls and a roof; it's our roots, our memories. Selling it or dividing it up—it's like they're chipping away at her memory, at our past. I just wish they could see how important this is, beyond the dollars and cents.
